stylePrompt: Mature learner-facing educational illustration, landscape 3:2, one clear focal meaning, varied painterly or naturalist styles, no photographic or live-action impression, no in-image teaching text, logos or watermarks. Every readable face has natural features and complete hands. Avoid blank faces, chibi proportions, glossy toy rendering, realistic skin pores, stock-photo staging and readable interfaces.

items.sentenceEn: She finds the average by sharing twelve oranges equally among three baskets.
items.sentenceZh: 她把十二个橙子平均分到三个篮子里，从而求出平均数。
items.scene: One adult arranges exactly twelve oranges equally into exactly three baskets, leaving four clearly countable oranges in each basket to show the average.
items.altText: 一名成年人把十二个橙子平均放进三个篮子，每篮正好四个。

items.sentenceEn: A butterfly begins to emerge from its chrysalis.
items.sentenceZh: 一只蝴蝶开始从蛹中出现。
items.scene: One butterfly is visibly halfway out of one split chrysalis on a branch, its wings unfolding as it emerges into morning light.
items.altText: 一只蝴蝶正从裂开的蛹中显露出来并展开翅膀。

items.meaningZh: 优点；便利；好处；优势；有助于
items.sentenceEn: The ramp gives the loaded cart an advantage over the stairs.
items.sentenceZh: 坡道使装载货物的手推车比走楼梯更有优势。
items.scene: Exactly two adult workers move identical boxes toward the same raised platform: one rolls a loaded cart easily up a smooth ramp while the other struggles to carry a box on adjacent stairs, clearly showing the ramp's advantage.
items.altText: 两名工人搬运相同箱子，使用坡道和手推车的人明显比走楼梯的人轻松。

items.meaningZh: 快的；迅速的；敏捷的；灵敏的；急速的
items.sentenceEn: Her quick response keeps the papers dry.
items.sentenceZh: 她迅速的反应使文件没有淋湿。
items.scene: One adult reacts quickly as rain begins, swiftly pulling a stack of loose papers under a covered market stall while the first drops fall, with convincing motion and a clear saved result.
items.altText: 雨刚落下，一名成年人迅速把散放的文件拉到遮棚下。

items.sentenceEn: Her leadership guides the team safely across the stream.
items.sentenceZh: 她的领导使团队安全渡过小溪。
items.scene: Exactly four adult hikers pause at a stream crossing; one confident leader studies the terrain, points to a safe line of stepping stones and organizes the other three before they proceed.
items.altText: 四名徒步者在溪边停下，其中一名带队者指示安全的踏石路线。

items.sentenceEn: The mechanic earns payment for repairing the bicycle.
items.sentenceZh: 技师通过修理自行车获得报酬。
items.scene: Exactly two adults stand beside a freshly repaired bicycle: the satisfied customer hands several plain payment tokens to the mechanic in exchange for completed skilled work.
items.altText: 修好的自行车旁，顾客把报酬交给完成工作的技师。

items.sentenceEn: The blacksmith pounds the hot metal with a heavy hammer.
items.sentenceZh: 铁匠用重锤敲打炽热的金属。
items.scene: One adult blacksmith safely pounds a glowing piece of metal on an anvil with one heavy hammer, frozen at the downward impact with sparks and protective gear.
items.altText: 一名佩戴防护装备的铁匠用重锤敲打铁砧上的炽热金属。

items.sentenceEn: The stone foundation forms the basis of the new building.
items.sentenceZh: 石质地基构成新建筑的基础。
items.scene: A partly constructed timber building rests visibly on a strong continuous stone foundation, with one adult engineer inspecting the base so the supporting basis is unmistakable.
items.altText: 一座在建木结构建筑稳固地坐落在连续石质地基上，工程师正在检查。

items.meaningZh: 明亮的；聪明的；鲜明的；欢快的
items.sentenceEn: Bright sunlight fills the studio when she opens the shutters.
items.sentenceZh: 她打开百叶窗后，明亮的阳光洒满工作室。
items.scene: One adult opens broad wooden shutters and intense clean morning sunlight floods a previously shaded art studio, illuminating the whole room with a clear bright contrast.
items.altText: 一名成年人打开百叶窗，明亮的晨光立即洒满工作室。

items.sentenceEn: The technician operates the lifting machine from the control station.
items.sentenceZh: 技术员从控制台操作起重设备。
items.scene: One adult technician safely operates a compact warehouse lifting machine using two clearly visible physical control levers while watching a crate rise, with no readable screen or interface.
items.altText: 一名技术员通过两个控制杆操作仓库起重机提升箱子。

items.sentenceEn: The host welcomes her guest at the front door.
items.sentenceZh: 主人在前门迎接她的客人。
items.scene: Exactly two adults meet at a warm home entrance: the host opens the door and gestures invitingly inside while the arriving guest holds a small bouquet and removes a coat.
items.altText: 住宅门口，主人开门邀请手捧花束的客人进屋。

items.sentenceEn: The scientist collects a small water sample from the river.
items.sentenceZh: 科学家从河中采集少量水样。
items.scene: One adult field scientist kneels safely at a riverbank and fills one small clear vial with a small amount of river water, holding it up as a representative sample of the much larger river.
items.altText: 一名野外科学家在河岸用小透明瓶采集少量河水样本。

items.sentenceEn: Each neighbor contributes an ingredient to the community meal.
items.sentenceZh: 每位邻居都为社区聚餐贡献一种食材。
items.scene: Exactly four adults gather around one shared cooking pot, and each visibly contributes one different ingredient—carrots, tomatoes, beans and herbs—into the common meal.
items.altText: 四名成年人分别把胡萝卜、番茄、豆子和香草加入同一口社区餐锅。

items.sentenceEn: A tiny frog rests on the tip of her gloved finger.
items.sentenceZh: 一只很小的青蛙停在她戴手套的指尖。
items.scene: One extremely tiny tree frog rests on the tip of one adult naturalist's gloved index finger, with the large hand providing an unmistakable size comparison and the frog's anatomy sharply clear.
items.altText: 一只极小的树蛙停在成年人戴手套的食指尖，手指形成明显大小对比。

items.sentenceEn: A fallen tree blocks the mountain road.
items.sentenceZh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了山路。
items.scene: One large fallen tree lies completely across a narrow mountain road from edge to edge, physically blocking one stopped car while the adult driver safely assesses the obstruction.
items.altText: 一棵倒下的大树横跨整条山路，挡住了一辆停下的汽车。

items.sentenceEn: The sturdy canopy provides protection from the heavy rain.
items.sentenceZh: 坚固的遮棚为人们提供免受大雨侵袭的保护。
items.scene: Exactly two adults stand dry beneath one sturdy roadside canopy during heavy rain, while sheets of water fall visibly outside the shelter and their clothes and supplies remain protected.
items.altText: 两名成年人和物品在坚固遮棚下保持干燥，棚外正下着大雨。

items.sentenceEn: They begin to settle into their new home.
items.sentenceZh: 他们开始在新家安顿下来。
items.scene: Exactly two adults settle into a new home by unpacking boxes, placing books on shelves and arranging one familiar framed picture, with growing order and comfort replacing the moving clutter.
items.altText: 两名成年人在新家拆箱、放书并摆好照片，逐渐安顿下来。

items.sentenceEn: The farmer comes every morning to feed the chickens.
items.sentenceZh: 农场主每天早晨来喂鸡。
items.scene: One adult farmer scatters grain from a small bucket to feed exactly four chickens, all four birds visibly pecking at the fresh food in a clean farmyard.
items.altText: 一名农场主撒下谷粒，四只鸡正在啄食。

items.sentenceEn: She walks along the shore to collect fallen seashells.
items.sentenceZh: 她沿着海岸收集散落的贝壳。
items.scene: One adult naturalist walks along a quiet shore and collects several empty seashells one by one into a woven basket, with a visible trail of scattered shells leading to the growing collection.
items.altText: 一名成年人沿海岸把散落的空贝壳逐个收进编织篮。

items.sentenceEn: The host brings an additional chair for the unexpected guest.
items.sentenceZh: 主人为意外到来的客人搬来一把额外的椅子。
items.scene: A dining table is already set with exactly four matching chairs while one adult host visibly carries a fifth matching chair toward the table as the clearly additional item.
items.altText: 餐桌原有四把配套椅子，主人正搬来第五把额外的椅子。
